items.question: By what means does the prescribed action counter both wind disorders and specific afflictions in this claim?
premises: Eighty wind disorders are subject to destruction.
Leprosy stands as a distinct affliction to be addressed.
A single action is said to destroy disease as well.
items.inference: The stated action destroys eighty winds and also destroys leprosy and disease.
uncertainties: Scope of 'eighty winds' remains unspecified by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: It destroys eighty winds; indeed it destroys leprosy and disease.
